name: ULN2003
notes: Seven Darlington sinks, up to 500 mA each, with 5 V inputs. COM goes to the load's supply when the load is a coil, for its flyback diodes. The output drops about 1 V when on.
spice:
.subckt CHIP_ULN2003 in1 in2 in3 in4 in5 in6 in7 gnd com out7 out6 out5 out4 out3 out2 out1
.model ULN_D D(Is=2.5n N=1.75)
Ri1 in1 gnd 10k
Bq1 out1 gnd I = max(v(out1,gnd)-0.9,0)/1*lunes_step(v(in1,gnd)-1.7,20)
D1 out1 com ULN_D
Ri2 in2 gnd 10k
Bq2 out2 gnd I = max(v(out2,gnd)-0.9,0)/1*lunes_step(v(in2,gnd)-1.7,20)
D2 out2 com ULN_D
Ri3 in3 gnd 10k
Bq3 out3 gnd I = max(v(out3,gnd)-0.9,0)/1*lunes_step(v(in3,gnd)-1.7,20)
D3 out3 com ULN_D
Ri4 in4 gnd 10k
Bq4 out4 gnd I = max(v(out4,gnd)-0.9,0)/1*lunes_step(v(in4,gnd)-1.7,20)
D4 out4 com ULN_D
Ri5 in5 gnd 10k
Bq5 out5 gnd I = max(v(out5,gnd)-0.9,0)/1*lunes_step(v(in5,gnd)-1.7,20)
D5 out5 com ULN_D
Ri6 in6 gnd 10k
Bq6 out6 gnd I = max(v(out6,gnd)-0.9,0)/1*lunes_step(v(in6,gnd)-1.7,20)
D6 out6 com ULN_D
Ri7 in7 gnd 10k
Bq7 out7 gnd I = max(v(out7,gnd)-0.9,0)/1*lunes_step(v(in7,gnd)-1.7,20)
D7 out7 com ULN_D
.ends CHIP_ULN2003
